snippet.title: Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at puzzles you'll solve and gameplay from Secrets of Blackrock Manor in this trailer for the upcoming escape room game. Secrets of Blackrock Manor will be available on PC in July 2025.

Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...
